title: Correct formula application
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly apply the formula F = BIL for Ampere force on a straight wire.

title: Correct numerical answer
description: Essential Criteria: Student must arrive at the final answer of 0.5 N (or equivalent).

title: Unit inclusion
description: Important Criteria: Student must include the correct unit (N) with their numerical answer.

title: Angle consideration
description: Important Criteria: Student must recognize that the wire is perpendicular to the field, making sinθ = 1 in the formula F = BILsinθ.

title: Substitution accuracy
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly substitute all given values (B=0.5 T, I=2 A, L=0.5 m) into the formula.

title: Missing sinθ factor
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student uses F = BIL without justifying sinθ = 1 for perpendicular orientation.

title: Unit conversion error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly converts units or omits them entirely in the final answer.

title: Direction specification
description: Optional Criteria: Student may use the right-hand rule to determine the direction of the force.
